aircraft_change_note.fighter_mix: Late Zuisei Zero remains the numerical core. A small priority layer of Kinsei Zero mod and Raiden/N1K2-J-type land interceptors improves climb/energy choices, but no A7M exists in combat.
aircraft_change_note.strike_recon_mix: D4Y/B6N and surviving land-attack/recon elements remain usable. C6N/Saiun-class scarce assets are protected for recontact rather than expended as ordinary bombers.

command_priority: Preserve a reconnaissance/attack skeleton for D-Day and for reporting the amphibious force. Do not burn every remaining fighter against rotating US carrier sweeps.

local_attack.result: CAP and heavy AA prevent a confirmed old-battleship hit by aircraft. Near misses and evasive maneuvering impose friction; coastal guns, not aircraft, produce the day's confirmed battleship damage.

end_14Jun.interpretation: The Marianas land-air system is badly degraded but not erased. It can still scout the invasion area and generate small local strikes on 15 Jun; it cannot contest theater air superiority.
